name: smwsprites-paper-mario-gulpit
title: Paper Mario Gulpit
description:
This is the Gulpit sprite from Paper Mario. It walks until it comes in contact with a rock sprite (included), after which it will gulp it and then spit it at the player.

Credit would be appreciated but isn't required. Note that it uses all of SP4.

Make sure to specify the sprite number of the rock in gulpit.asm! Check the ASM files for configuration options.

Demonstration video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lb0Lr6J9rJc
